tools.name: check_vin_recalls
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a vin decoder, recall check by vin, or batch vin decoder with vehicle recalls and XLSX and CSV reports from public NHTSA data. Up to 50 VINs and 40 source requests per call; campaigns apply to the year, make and model. Do not use for VIN-specific repair status or booking

tools.name: find_recalls_by_vehicle
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a car recall lookup, vehicle recalls, or fleet recall check by model year, make and model without a VIN, with public NHTSA data and XLSX and CSV reports. Up to 20 vehicles and 40 source requests per call. Do not use for VIN-specific repair status or booking repairs.
